request.feedback: REJECT R1-PROMPT-001: nginx_qa/telegram_launcher.py:287-291 constructs ManagedGitProvider directly and source_context writes/refetches its mirror before any protected-root/isolation validation. main.load_managed_runtime_config only normalizes environment; the importer normally enforces isolation in _assert_mutation_roots_safe, but this new path bypasses it. Reproduced with a temporary local Git fixture (local transport enabled only for fixture; delivery mocked): managed_root nested under protected_roots was accepted, repositories/ was created there, prompt export returned ok and delivery ran. The existing ManagedWorkspaceManager.validate_isolated_root rejects the identical path with WORKSPACE_ROOT_FORBIDDEN. Validate the original configured managed root read-only before constructing the provider or any mkdir/fetch, preserving reparse/parent-repository checks and excluding protected, service, Python/venv, runtime and prompt roots; return a safe stable launcher error. Add negative tests for protected/service/repository/reparse roots asserting zero Git, filesystem and delivery side effects. Do not create a managed import/control attempt merely to validate. All 82 existing prompt/envelope/schema/sequential UI tests pass independently; they currently omit this boundary. Also git diff --check reports a low-impact extra blank line at telegram_launcher.py:319. Runtime intake/activation remain outside this stage.
